concept.subject: A full moon through bare trees at twilight: dark trunks on the left, a web of bare branches and curling tendrils over the right half, the silver moon low in the middle of a mauve sky.
concept.composition: The main trunk stands at a fifth of the width from the top edge to the bottom, with a fork beside it and a second trunk leaning in from the left edge; a thick branch leaves the main trunk at four tenths of the height and rises to the top edge at the center, behind the cannon. The moon, a sixth of the width across, sits a little left of the center just below half the height, with a thin twig arching over it. On the right a long branch falls from a knot right of the top center to a trunk that curves from the top at four fifths of the width to the right edge at two thirds of the height; an arching branch runs above it, and under it a limb, a hanging twig, a tendril curling down and a branch sagging from the right trunk. Fine twigs rise along the bottom.
concept.layout: 62 round pegs and 89 bricks. The branches are the vines. The thick branch and the long branch on the right are brick slides that start just outside the cannon's clearance: one shot rides each from end to end, the left one on through a gap where it meets the main trunk into the sky between the left trunks. The trunks, the fork, the arching branches, the sagging branch, the hanging twig and the tendril are brick chains. The moon is a brick ring open underneath with three pegs on its dark seas, sheltered by the twig arching over it, a solid. Pegs follow the twigs: a vine winding down between the left trunks, two rows rising along the bottom, and sprigs among the branches on the right.

difficulty.note: The stage opener and its easiest level: two slides from beside the cannon light six and eleven bricks a shot. The solid twig arching over the moon shelters the top of its rim, the nearest bricks under the cannon, where the weighted draw puts two or three orange pegs.

background.prompt: A photo of a full moon through bare trees at twilight, dark gray silhouettes against a pale mauve sky. The pale silver moon, about a sixth of the picture wide, sits at about 0.46 of the width and 0.57 of the height, with a thin twig arching just over its top. On the left a main trunk rises from the bottom edge to the top edge at about a fifth of the width, a narrow fork beside it at about 0.27; a second trunk leans in from the left edge, and a thick branch leaves the main trunk at about 0.43 of the height and climbs to the top edge at the center. The right half is a web of bare branches: a trunk curves from the top edge at about 0.8 of the width to the right edge at about two thirds of the height, a long branch falls from a knot at about 0.55 of the width and a quarter of the height down to that trunk, an arching branch runs above it at about a third of the height, and under it hang a thin limb, a straight twig, a tendril curling down and a branch sagging from the trunk. Fine twigs rise along the bottom; the lower left corner shows the bases of the trunks, the lower right corner a few thick branch stubs.

picture.title: A stunning full moon captured through bare trees at twilight, casting a serene glow.
picture.author: Cara Denison
